title: Difluorodioxophosphate-Based Hollow Hexanuclear Lanthanide(III) Clusters Decorated with Tetrathiafulvalene Ligands

material_class.structural_family: hollow hexanuclear Ln6 core bridged by PO2F2- and mu3-OH- and decorated by two neutral TTF ligands L

synthesis.procedure: Galvanostatic electrocrystallization. The anodic compartment was filled with 0.02 mmol of Dy(hfac)3·2H2O (16.4 mg), 10.5 mg of L (0.02 mmol), and 100 mg of TBAPF6 in 13 mL of CH2Cl2/n-hexane (1:1 v/v). The cathodic compartment was filled with 100 mg of TBAPF6 in 10 mL of the same solvent mixture. A courant of 1.5 μA was applied for 5 days, giving orange sticks of 1 suitable for X-ray crystallography. Disordered CH2Cl2 of crystallization was removed by PLATON/SQUEEZE.

reagents.name: tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate (TBAPF6)
reagents.role: electrolyte and PO2F2 source via partial PF6 hydrolysis

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange sticks formed in the cell and were used directly for single-crystal X-ray diffraction; lattice CH2Cl2 was disordered and squeezed.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT matches six noninteracting Dy(III) ions and decreases on cooling because of MJ depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic exchange/dipolar interactions. Magnetization rises rapidly at low field but does not saturate fully. AC susceptibility shows negligible out-of-phase signal under 0 and 1000 Oe, so SMM behavior is not observed. Solid-state UV–visible absorption of 1 closely matches the free TTF ligand (ILCT, intradonor, and intraacceptor bands); the metal core does not absorb in the measured range.

material_class.structural_family: hollow hexanuclear Ln6 core bridged by PO2F2- and mu3-OH- and decorated by two neutral TTF ligands L; isostructural with 1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same galvanostatic procedure as 1. The anodic compartment contained 0.02 mmol of Yb(hfac)3·2H2O (16.5 mg), 10.5 mg of L (0.02 mmol), and 100 mg of TBAPF6 in 13 mL of CH2Cl2/n-hexane (1:1 v/v); the cathode contained 100 mg of TBAPF6 in 10 mL of the same mixture. A courant of 1.5 μA was applied for 5 days, affording orange sticks of 2. CH2Cl2 was located in the lattice and solvent-accessible voids were treated by SQUEEZE.

reagents.name: tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate (TBAPF6)
reagents.role: electrolyte and PO2F2 source via partial PF6 hydrolysis

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange sticks suitable for X-ray crystallography; lattice CH2Cl2 disordered and squeezed. CCDC formula retains 0.25 CH2Cl2.

properties.summary: No magnetic data are reported for the Yb cluster. The solid-state UV–visible absorption of the hexanuclear complexes is described as essentially identical to that of free L because the metallic core does not absorb in the studied range; the numerical spectrum and Gaussian fit are given only for 1.
